site_name: St. Lawrence R C Primary School
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of the secure entry system should be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the installation of the security gates.

Condition : 4 - A detailed plan indicating the following shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority before commencement of building works on site:a)	Car park lighting b)	Protection of the fence against parking bays 10-24 c) Indicate different surface treatment for pedestrian pavement crossover and approach to gates d) Fencing off the two areas of dead space to the northeast of the site close to the vehicle entrance.
Condition : 5 - The two fences parallel to Victoria Road should have metal bars set at least 6 inches apart.
description: Erection of security gates and fencing to the car parking entrance of the school and the installation of 10 new car parking spaces to the school car park.
